title: Depth moves one way
description: The index (column 1) moves strictly one way. The direction is the sign of the last non-null index minus the first; equal, or fewer than two non-null values, is increasing, so a descending log passes. Row 1 fails when its index is null; a later row fails when it is null or does not move strictly in the direction from the last non-null index before it.
